import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# 1. Top-left: Sales by Product Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette('YlOrBr', len(product_sales))
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for bar, val in zip(bars1, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Top-right: Sales by Customer Age Group
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
colors2 = sns.color_palette('Blues_d', len(age_sales))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors2,
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(age_sales), startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Bottom-left: Average Transaction by Size and Product
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='product', columns='size', aggfunc='mean')
pivot_data = pivot_data.reindex(columns=size_order)
pivot_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=sns.color_palette('Greens_d', 3), edgecolor='black', width=0.75)
ax3.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Transaction ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Average Transaction Value by Product & Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Size', loc='upper right')
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

# 4. Bottom-right: Payment Method and Takeaway Analysis
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Group by payment method and takeaway status
df['takeaway_status'] = df['is_takeaway'].map({1: 'Takeaway', 0: 'Dine-in'})
payment_takeaway = df.groupby(['payment_method', 'takeaway_status'])['total'].sum().unstack()
payment_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], edgecolor='black', width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Sales by Payment Method & Order Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Order Type', loc='upper right')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)

# Add summary statistics as text
total_revenue = df['total'].sum()
avg_transaction = df['total'].mean()
total_transactions = len(df)

fig.text(0.5, -0.02, f'Summary: Total Revenue: ${total_revenue:,.2f} | Total Transactions: {total_transactions:,} | Avg Transaction: ${avg_transaction:.2f}', 
         ha='center', fontsize=11, style='italic', 
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
